features: candidate signature, mean candidate signature, difference from that mean; candidate-order equivariant
target: actual complete-set IoU minus the mean candidate IoU within the same query
prediction: one set-conditioned potential per candidate; replacement gain is potential(candidate) minus potential(incumbent)
hypothesis: consistent set-relative utility generalizes better than unconstrained ordered-pair regression; calibration ordering motivates the test, not a proved causal explanation
design_trigger: joint pairwise model calibrated to reject all because its highest predicted image gain was harmful on separate calibration data
